title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Metaphor Creations, LLC…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Ditty News Ticker by Metaphor Creations, LLC, due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This allows code injection in affected versions up to 3.1.71. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
